verdicts.proof: Old: every SOS entry is gated by Reservation.sosAllowed (reservation_models.dart:423) or hasActiveRentalProvider: home_reservations_section.dart:108, reservation_card.dart:164, res_detail_tab_content.dart:303, profile_screen.dart:383, ai_agent_screen.dart (canSos before isSosHint), notification_handler.dart:133. grep of all lib for Routes.sos finds exactly these v2 entries: home_bookings_v2.dart:63-66 (active.any(sosAllowed), same paid active/upcoming list as old home_screen.dart:61, home_screen_v2.dart:91-94); res_card_actions_v2.dart:123/156/180 (_SosButton only when aktivni && sosAllowed, :225 push); v2 detail reuses shared res_detail_tab_content.dart:303 with ResDetailButton v2 look (res_detail_parts_v2.dart:33); profile_groups_v2.dart:55/76 (hasActiveRentalProvider); AI chat v2 shows AiSosCardV2 only for isSosHint messages (ai_chat_view_v2.dart:107) built by the shared screen logic with canSos; notification handler is shared. The shell SOS strip (shell_fab_layer.dart:270-303) is the pending-SOS-replacement strip for an existing incident, not a new SOS entry. No v2 file pushes '/sos' by string. Note: the chunk's evidence names files that do not exist (home_ticket_v2.dart, res_coted_v2.dart, profile_attention_v2.dart); the verdict holds on the files that do exist. Hiding is silent in both looks (same as old).

sos_report_screen.dart:36-47 builds one statusError MgErrorView (title, retry, SosCallButton); old look renders it at :105, v2 receives it at :51 (activeAsync.whenOrNull(error:)) and renders it at sos_start_view_v2.dart:57. SosCallButton has a v2 MgBtnSos look (sos_feedback.dart:105). Same widget, same retry (ref.invalidate(activeSosProvider)).

sos_provider.dart:225-237: createSosIncident returns the open serious incident instead of inserting. All report paths, old and v2, go through the shared _report/_submitReport (sos_report_screen.dart:287-336) or the shared sub-screen handlers; the v2 type sheets call the same _report (sos_report_screen.dart:219-226, 254-261). features/sos/v2 contains no Supabase insert. Server trigger trg_one_active_sos is independent. Silent in both looks.

sos_provider.dart:240-243 calls _findActiveBookingId (:268-293) only when bookingId is null; _submitReport (sos_report_screen.dart:320-326) never passes bookingId, and that path is the same for both looks. No v2 code calls createSosIncident with a bookingId (v2 views only receive callbacks).

_submitReport opens SosProgress.show without cancelAfter (sos_report_screen.dart:307); SosProgress = MgProgress (sos_feedback.dart:17). MgProgress.show uses barrierDismissible:false (error_feedback.dart:265) and _MgProgressDialog wraps BOTH looks in PopScope(canPop:false) with cancel only when cancelAfter != null; the v2 look is just v2ProgressDialogLook with onCancel null because _canCancel stays false. Same _submitReport reached from the v2 type sheets (sos_report_screen.dart:220-221, 255-256).

sos_report_screen.dart:327-335 catches the createSosIncident error and calls showSosActionFailed; in v2 it shows showSosFailSheetV2 (sos_feedback.dart:32-33, sos_feedback_v2.dart:18-33) with an SOS-tone state sheet (title + reason) and buttons call / 112 / retry returning the same ids. Closing returns null = no retry, as closing the old dialog. No success is claimed because the function returns before the success toast and push.

sos_report_screen.dart:338-361 is shared by both looks: photosFailed -> showMotoGoToast with title 'photoUploadFailed' and 'eoSosPhotosLater' for 8 s. There is no v2 branch in this step, so the v2 customer sees exactly the same toast (small-text in both looks, unchanged).

Old row sos_report_screen.dart:180-185 and v2 row sos_start_view_v2.dart:74-80 both call the same _shareLocation (sos_report_screen.dart:55, 383-393): blocking progress, shareLocationNow, then showSosLocationResult. In v2 success = showSosLocSentV2 toast only when r == ok (sos_feedback.dart:51-55); failure = showSosLocFailSheetV2 with title, reason body, 'Open settings' on the same condition (settings = noPermission || serviceOff, sos_feedback.dart:67, sos_feedback_v2.dart:45-48), call and retry; same return ids handled at sos_feedback.dart:81-86.

Old: sos_report_screen.dart:96-103 shows _ActiveBanner only when inc != null && inc.isActive (isActive = status not resolved/closed, sos_provider.dart:112), tap -> Routes.sosDone. v2: sos_start_view_v2.dart:56 same condition -> SosActiveBannerV2 (:87-135) with heading 'activeSosIncident', status + short id, tap hint, chevron; onTap = onOpenIncident = push(Routes.sosDone) (sos_report_screen.dart:57). Same activeSosProvider.

activeSosProvider/_fetchActiveIncident (sos_provider.dart:163-172) is shared: newest non-resolved incident, limit 1. Old hides the banner on first load (:104); v2 uses active.valueOrNull (sos_start_view_v2.dart:45), which is null on first load, so no banner either. On a failed refresh with earlier data v2 shows both the stale banner and the error card; old shows only the error card. That shows more, not less.

The v2 accident sheet row 'minorAccidentContinue' (sos_report_screen.dart:219-221) calls the same _report, which awaits collectSosReport and aborts on null (:291-292). sos_sheets_v2.dart:35-38 pops the type sheet, then runs the callback. collectSosReport (sos_report_sheet.dart:24-35) is shared: isDismissible false, enableDrag false, PopScope with discard confirm. canSubmit (desc >= 3 chars and a photo, or a camera problem) is computed once (:94-96) and passed to SosReportSheetV2 as onSubmit: canSubmit ? submit : null, plus missingDesc/missingPhoto lines that say what is missing.

The v2 accident sheet rows push the same routes as the old picker: Routes.sosAccident (sos_report_screen.dart:222-223 vs :241-242) and Routes.sosTheft (:224-225 vs :243-244). No v2 row calls _report for these types.

The v2 breakdown sheet row 'minorDefectContinue' (sos_report_screen.dart:255-256) calls the same _report(SosType.breakdownMinor) as the old :274-275, so the same mandatory collectSosReport sheet runs first (see G-673). The other two rows push the same Routes.sosBreakdown / Routes.sosService as the old ones (:257-260 vs :276-279).
